name: Goblinvine Oil
body:
Price 125 gp; Weight —;

ABOUT

Extracted from the mashed leaves of the pernicious goblinvine, this irritant is favored by goblins and tricksters alike.

DETAILS

Type poison, contact; Save Fortitude DC 10; Onset 1 round; Cure 2 consecutive saves or 1 minute spent washing the affected area

EFFECT

Sickened
